definitions.short: Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H851. Eshtemoa אֶשְׁתְּמוֺעַ Josh 21:14 , אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ 1Sam 30:28 ; 1Chr 4:17 , 19 ; 6:42 , אֶשְׁתְּמֹה Josh 15:50 proper name, of a location Levitical city in mountain-country of Judah , south of Hebron, modern Semû±­ see Rob BR i. 464, ii. 204 Survey iii. 403 Bd Pal. 153 ; 1Chr 4:17 , 19 it appears as proper name, masculine of a man of Judah . (On the form, compare below אֶשְׁתָּאוֺל .)
